_comment: Every source the Workshop imports. tools/fetch_sources.py downloads the 'git' sources into data/raw/<id> at the pinned commit, the 'http' sources at the pinned SHA-256, and the 'archive' sources (Internet Archive files) at the SHA-256 pinned for each file.
